MonsterTools.Title: Boss Loot Monster Tools
MonsterTools.Subtitle: Adjust NPC stats to CR rules.
MonsterTools.LimitCRChangeTooltip: Limits the CR change to +/- 5 steps of the original. Highly recommended to preserve balance.
MonsterTools.PreviewHint: Preview values. Select what to apply above.
MonsterTools.AbilityScoresTooltip: Ability Scores: compares current CR to New CR, then adds or subtracts that difference from ability scores above 10 (never below 10, never above 30) based on the Guidelines Table.
MonsterTools.DamageDiceScaleTooltip: Damage Dice Scale: compares current CR to New CR, then increases or decreases the number of damage dice (minimum 1) based on the Guidelines Table.
MonsterTools.MultipleSelectedHint: Multiple selected: changes apply to all.
MonsterTools.TokenNamePlaceholderSingle: Leave blank to keep current name.
